meta.title: A vendor's draft bid is visible only to the user who started it
gaps: the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: The setup does not explicitly guarantee that vendor user 2 is a distinct user from the same vendor company.
The available read_bid operation does not expose a documented draft-visibility field, so the plan uses HTTP 404 as the invisibility assertion.
